summary: 13 attack steps between 01:10 and 03:18 UTC: Reconnaissance -> Initial Access -> Persistence -> Execution -> Discovery -> Command and Control -> Credential Access -> Privilege Escalation -> Lateral Movement -> Collection -> Exfiltration

steps.title: Web scanning of WEB-PORTAL-01 from 203.0.113.66
steps.description: Between 01:10 and 01:11 on 2026-11-03, 203.0.113.66 sent a rapid series of requests to WEB-PORTAL-01 (10.10.1.10) for admin, backup, config and API paths, using the Nmap Scripting Engine user agent. Most returned 404, with some 301 and 403 responses.

steps.title: SQL injection against /login.aspx from 203.0.113.66
steps.description: At 01:19 on 2026-11-03, sqlmap/1.7.8 sent SQL injection payloads (OR '1'='1 and UNION SELECT) to /login.aspx on WEB-PORTAL-01. The server returned 500 for the first two requests and 302 for the OR '1'='1 request.

steps.title: Web shell img_upd.aspx uploaded and used with cmd= parameters
steps.description: At 01:31 on 2026-11-03, 203.0.113.66 POSTed to /shipments/upload.aspx?name=img_upd.aspx on WEB-PORTAL-01 and received 200. From 01:33 to 02:04 the same client requested /img_upd.aspx with cmd= values (ipconfig /all, net user, dir, encoded powershell, rundll32 comsvcs MiniDump), and each request returned 200.

steps.title: w3wp.exe spawned cmd.exe under LOGISTIK\svc_web
steps.description: The IIS worker process w3wp.exe on WEB-PORTAL-01 created cmd.exe as LOGISTIK\svc_web for each web shell command: whoami, ipconfig /all, net user k.hafiz /domain, dir D:\Shares\Logistik, and the rundll32 comsvcs.dll MiniDump command.

steps.title: Domain account and share discovery through the web shell
steps.description: Through the web shell, svc_web ran net user k.hafiz /domain at 01:38 and cmd /c dir D:\Shares\Logistik at 01:44 on WEB-PORTAL-01. Both requests returned 200.

steps.title: Encoded PowerShell launched by w3wp.exe on WEB-PORTAL-01
steps.description: At 01:52:03 w3wp.exe started powershell.exe as LOGISTIK\svc_web with -nop -w hidden -enc and a Base64 encoded command. The decoded content is not available in these records, so only the launch is reported.

steps.title: Encoded PowerShell on WEB-PORTAL-01 connected to 198.51.100.77:443
steps.description: Shortly after the encoded PowerShell launch, powershell.exe (PID 4188) running as LOGISTIK\svc_web on WEB-PORTAL-01 opened a connection to 198.51.100.77 on port 443 at 01:52:40.

steps.title: LSASS memory access via comsvcs MiniDump on WEB-PORTAL-01
steps.description: At 02:04 cmd.exe spawned rundll32.exe with comsvcs.dll MiniDump against PID 648 writing C:\Users\Public\lsass.dmp. rundll32.exe (PID 4241) then opened lsass.exe with GrantedAccess 0x1FFFFF, and the file lsass.dmp was created. The records do not show the dump contents, so exposed credentials cannot be confirmed from these events.

steps.title: Explicit-credential logon from WEB-PORTAL-01 to FS-LOGISTIK-01 as LOGISTIK\k.hafiz
steps.description: At 02:21:33 LOGISTIK\k.hafiz made an explicit-credential logon from WEB-PORTAL-01 (10.10.1.10) to FS-LOGISTIK-01 (10.10.3.20). FS-LOGISTIK-01 recorded a successful type 3 logon for the same account from 10.10.1.10 two seconds later.

steps.title: Administrative share ADMIN$ accessed on FS-LOGISTIK-01 from 10.10.1.10
steps.description: At 02:21:38 FS-LOGISTIK-01 recorded access to \\*\ADMIN$ from 10.10.1.10 under LOGISTIK\k.hafiz.

steps.title: PsExec service installed and started on FS-LOGISTIK-01
steps.description: At 02:21:40 PSEXESVC was installed on FS-LOGISTIK-01 from C:\Windows\PSEXESVC.exe and started under services.exe. At 02:22:02 a cmd.exe was spawned by psexesvc.exe in the context of LOGISTIK\k.hafiz.

steps.title: Archive staging with 7z.exe on FS-LOGISTIK-01
steps.description: At 02:40 cmd.exe launched 7z.exe as LOGISTIK\k.hafiz to create C:\Users\Public\q4.7z from D:\Shares\Logistik\Jadual_Penghantaran_Q4\*, with a password switch (-pP@ss) visible on the command line. The archive file q4.7z was created at 02:41.

steps.title: Outbound upload of q4.7z to 198.51.100.77 (~432 MB)
steps.description: At 03:18 curl.exe under cmd.exe, running as LOGISTIK\k.hafiz on FS-LOGISTIK-01, uploaded C:\Users\Public\q4.7z with -T to https://198.51.100.77/u, and connected to 198.51.100.77:443 from 10.10.3.20. PA-FW-01 logged an allowed session to 198.51.100.77 port 443 at 03:44 with 412 MB (432013312 bytes) sent.
